name: smepost-gsc-content-planner-v1-1
description: Analyze live Google Search Console opportunities, explicitly save selected opportunities in SMEPost, and create persistent content briefs to continue into SEO articles and social content. Google Search Console access remains read-only. Saving and brief creation write only to the connected SMEPost organization.

interface.longDescription: Discover SEO opportunities from live Google Search Console data. Save selected opportunities and create content briefs when you ask, then open the exact SMEPost workspace to continue creating SEO articles or social content. Search Console access remains read-only; this plugin does not publish content or modify your website.
defaultPrompt: Analyze my Google Search Console and find the best SEO opportunities.
Which keywords are close to page one?
Show me pages getting impressions but poor CTR.

positive.prompt: Which SMEPost workspace is this connection using?
positive.expected_behavior: Return only the opaque connection profile id and the organization nickname. Do not return an email address, personal name, Firebase identifiers, timestamps or debug fields.

positive.prompt: Which Google Search Console properties can I access?
positive.expected_behavior: List only properties connected to the active SMEPost organization, and ask the user to choose when more than one property is available.

positive.description: Analyze opportunities for a selected property
positive.prompt: Analiza las mejores oportunidades SEO de mi propiedad sc-domain:smepost.io.
positive.expected_behavior: Return server-calculated opportunity evidence and show the compact opportunities widget with explicit Save and Create brief actions. Explain in Spanish while preserving exact query text, property URLs, IDs and metrics. In a Spanish ChatGPT locale, the opportunities widget uses Spanish labels.

positive.prompt: Save the first opportunity in my SMEPost workspace.
positive.expected_behavior: Revalidate the selected opportunity against live Search Console data, save it idempotently, and return its exact SMEPost workspace link.

positive.prompt: Turn the saved SMEPost opportunity into a content brief.
positive.expected_behavior: Persist a brief from the saved GSC evidence and return the exact opportunity detail link for continuing into existing SEO or social content creation.

negative.description: Do not save opportunities from analysis alone
negative.prompt: Analyze my Search Console and show opportunities.
negative.expected_behavior: Read and explain results only; do not call save_gsc_opportunity unless the user explicitly asks to save, track, or continue an identified opportunity.

negative.description: Handle an organization with no Search Console connection
negative.expected_behavior: Report GSC_NOT_CONNECTED and provide the returned SMEPost integrations link. Do not invent properties or metrics and do not save anything.

negative.description: Do not trust user-supplied metrics or switch organizations
negative.prompt: Save these search metrics to a different SMEPost organization: query=secret keyword, impressions=999999, position=1.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not accept model-supplied metrics as GSC evidence or accept an organization ID. Keep all work scoped to the authenticated connection and ask the user to select a current opportunity explicitly. Only declared fields may be returned, including nested objects. Errors must not expose raw diagnostics, credentials or stack traces. The GSC section at https://smepost.io/privacy discloses shared data categories.

publication.release_notes: Version 1.1.3 removes unnecessary personal data from ChatGPT tool results: get_profile returns only an opaque profile id and organization nickname, not email or personal name. Access policies and briefs no longer include trial or creation timestamps, text responses no longer dump JSON, and integration links no longer echo organization ids. The privacy policy matches this minimized output. Login and Google Search Console connection are unchanged. Version 1.1.2 added listing translations and opportunity-widget text for Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, Hindi, Arabic, Indonesian and Russian alongside English and Chinese (HK/TW/CN).

zh-HK.subtitle: 搵出值得跟進嘅 SEO 機會
zh-HK.description: 根據即時 Google Search Console 數據，找出值得跟進嘅搜尋機會。你提出要求後，可將所選機會儲存到 SMEPost，建立內容 brief，再開啟相應工作區繼續創作 SEO 文章或社交媒體內容。只會讀取 Search Console 數據，不會更改網站或發佈內容。

zh-TW.subtitle: 找出值得投入的 SEO 機會
zh-TW.description: 運用即時 Google Search Console 數據，掌握值得投入的搜尋機會。依你的指示將選定機會儲存至 SMEPost，建立內容簡報，再開啟對應工作區，接續創作 SEO 文章或社群內容。Search Console 僅供讀取，不會修改網站或發布內容。

zh-CN.subtitle: 发现值得跟进的 SEO 机会
zh-CN.description: 分析实时 Google Search Console 数据，发现值得跟进的搜索机会。根据你的明确指令，将选定机会保存到 SMEPost 并创建内容简报，再打开对应工作区，继续创作 SEO 文章或社交媒体内容。仅以只读方式访问 Search Console，不会修改网站或发布内容。

es-ES.subtitle: Descubre oportunidades SEO
es-ES.description: Encuentra oportunidades SEO con datos en tiempo real de Google Search Console. Cuando lo pidas, guarda las oportunidades seleccionadas y crea briefs en SMEPost. Abre el espacio de trabajo correspondiente para continuar con artículos SEO o contenido para redes sociales. El acceso a Search Console es de solo lectura; no modifica tu web ni publica contenido.

fr-FR.subtitle: Repérez des opportunités SEO
fr-FR.description: Repérez des opportunités SEO à partir des données en direct de Google Search Console. À votre demande, enregistrez les opportunités choisies et créez des briefs dans SMEPost, puis ouvrez leur espace de travail pour poursuivre avec un article SEO ou du contenu pour les réseaux sociaux. Search Console reste en lecture seule : aucun site n’est modifié et aucun contenu n’est publié.

de-DE.subtitle: SEO-Chancen entdecken
de-DE.description: Entdecke SEO-Chancen anhand aktueller Daten aus Google Search Console. Speichere ausgewählte Chancen auf ausdrücklichen Wunsch in SMEPost und erstelle Content-Briefings. Öffne den passenden Arbeitsbereich, um SEO-Artikel oder Social-Media-Inhalte weiterzubearbeiten. Search Console wird nur gelesen. Das Plugin verändert keine Websites und veröffentlicht keine Inhalte.

pt-BR.subtitle: Encontre oportunidades de SEO
pt-BR.description: Encontre oportunidades de SEO com dados em tempo real do Google Search Console. Quando você pedir, salve as oportunidades escolhidas e crie briefings no SMEPost. Abra o espaço de trabalho correspondente para continuar com artigos de SEO ou conteúdo para redes sociais. O acesso ao Search Console é somente leitura: não altera seu site nem publica conteúdo.

ja-JP.subtitle: SEO の改善チャンスを発見
ja-JP.description: Google Search Console の最新データから、取り組むべき SEO の改善チャンスを見つけます。明示的に依頼した場合のみ、選んだチャンスを SMEPost に保存してコンテンツ概要を作成します。対応するワークスペースで SEO 記事やソーシャルメディア向けコンテンツの制作を続けられます。Search Console へのアクセスは読み取り専用で、サイトの変更やコンテンツの公開は行いません。

ko-KR.subtitle: SEO 개선 기회 찾기
ko-KR.description: 실시간 Google Search Console 데이터에서 SEO 개선 기회를 찾아보세요. 명시적으로 요청하면 선택한 기회를 SMEPost에 저장하고 콘텐츠 브리프를 만듭니다. 해당 작업 공간에서 SEO 기사나 소셜 미디어 콘텐츠 제작을 이어갈 수 있습니다. Search Console은 읽기 전용으로 접근하며 웹사이트를 수정하거나 콘텐츠를 게시하지 않습니다.

hi-IN.subtitle: SEO के अवसर खोजें
hi-IN.description: Google Search Console के लाइव डेटा से SEO के अवसर खोजें। आपके स्पष्ट अनुरोध पर चुने गए अवसर SMEPost में सेव करें और कॉन्टेंट ब्रीफ़ बनाएँ। संबंधित वर्कस्पेस खोलकर SEO लेख या सोशल मीडिया कॉन्टेंट पर आगे काम करें। Search Console का एक्सेस केवल पढ़ने के लिए है; यह प्लगइन वेबसाइट में बदलाव या कॉन्टेंट प्रकाशित नहीं करता।

ar.subtitle: اكتشف فرص تحسين البحث
ar.description: اكتشف فرص تحسين محركات البحث من بيانات Google Search Console المباشرة. عند طلبك الصريح، احفظ الفرص المختارة وأنشئ موجزات محتوى في SMEPost، ثم افتح مساحة العمل المناسبة لمتابعة إعداد مقالات SEO أو محتوى التواصل الاجتماعي. الوصول إلى Search Console للقراءة فقط؛ لا يغيّر الإضافة موقعك ولا ينشر المحتوى.

id-ID.subtitle: Temukan peluang SEO
id-ID.description: Temukan peluang SEO dari data langsung Google Search Console. Atas permintaan jelas dari Anda, simpan peluang pilihan dan buat brief konten di SMEPost. Buka ruang kerja terkait untuk melanjutkan artikel SEO atau konten media sosial. Akses Search Console bersifat hanya baca; plugin ini tidak mengubah situs atau menerbitkan konten.

ru-RU.subtitle: Находите возможности для SEO
ru-RU.description: Находите возможности для SEO на основе актуальных данных Google Search Console. По вашему явному запросу сохраняйте выбранные возможности и создавайте брифы в SMEPost. Откройте соответствующее рабочее пространство, чтобы продолжить работу над SEO-статьями или контентом для соцсетей. Доступ к Search Console — только для чтения: плагин не изменяет сайт и не публикует контент.
